root_cause.escaped_defect: Agents could remain inside long tool chains repeatedly checking required workflow jobs even when the exact-head workflow state had not changed.
root_cause.observed_pattern: The UI stayed on 'Controleren van vereiste workflowjobs' while successful/skipped siblings or unchanged queued/in-progress runs were re-read without new evidence.

prevention.single_snapshot: Take at most one exact-head top-level workflow snapshot per observation cycle.
prevention.failure_drilldown: On a terminal non-success, inspect only the first failed workflow/job/step once, then repair the cause.
prevention.unchanged_active: Queued or in-progress state is checkpointed; the same head/run/status fingerprint is not re-read for 120 seconds without new evidence.
prevention.sibling_reads: Successful or skipped sibling jobs are not repeatedly enumerated.
prevention.tool_budget: Each workflow observation cycle is capped at 3 status-tool reads and 30 wall-clock seconds; budget exhaustion forces checkpoint + independent work.
prevention.executable_guard: tools/delivery/predictive-controller.mjs#planWorkflowObservation converts active remote CI into CHECKPOINT_AND_CONTINUE_INDEPENDENT_WORK, forbids polling, and enforces the same snapshot/drilldown/tool/wall-clock budgets.

evaluation.expected: One exact-head workflow snapshot is sufficient for unchanged queued/in-progress state; the executable planner returns no-poll checkpoint behavior for active CI, terminal failures permit one failed workflow/job/step drilldown, and successful/skipped siblings are not repeatedly polled.

evidence.operational_proof: Auto-merge remains armed while active gates continue independently; chat execution does not wait on repeated job enumeration.
historical_observations: PR #3913 Required test run 37467204634 was diagnosable from one top-level snapshot plus one failed preflight drilldown.
PR #3917 and #3916 were observed with one exact-head workflow snapshot each while active gates continued independently.
